notes: Task 4a answers from the official Hueber answer key (Lektion 7 Kursbuch 4a, top to bottom: 5; 10; 8) - write-in circles next to each compliment; the first compliment (Sie können aber toll Ski fahren = Bild 1) is the printed example. Task 6a order from the key (6a left to right: gut; ein bisschen; nicht so gut; nicht; gar nicht); 'toll / sehr gut / super' is the printed example on the scale.

Task 5 (b Könnt ihr gut tanzen? c Sie können aber toll Ski fahren. d Er kann ja super Tennis spielen. e Können Sie Schach spielen? per key) is an AB task - the on-page table only holds the printed examples, the writing happens in the Arbeitsbuch, so no fields were created.

Estimated boxes: top photo-strip labels (missed by OCR), script-font examples (7 backen; table example rows; scale example toll/sehr/gut/super), the 4a write-in circles and the 6a line fields; 'ihr/könnt' conjugation row OCR height normalized. Circled photo numbers 1-10, AB markers, vertical GRAMMATIK tabs, smileys and footer digit 42 dropped as non-words.
No audio: tasks 4-6 carry AB (Arbeitsbuch) markers, not CD track markers.
